tool_schemas.name: generate_image
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new single-image generation job and a Replicate prediction for the provided prompt (and optional model_ref/input), then returns the created job/prediction record including its internal prediction id for subsequent polling and any available output artifact references. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prompt is missing/empty, model_ref is not a valid Replicate reference, or input is not an object; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when you exceed your generation limits; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when your credentials cannot create jobs/predictions.

prompt.description: Text prompt to generate a single image.

model_ref.description: Replicate model reference/version to use (defaults to Flux Schnell if omitted).

input.description: Additional Replicate model input parameters to pass through.

tool_schemas.name: generate_multiple_images
tool_schemas.description: Creates a batch generation job and one Replicate prediction per prompt in prompts, returning the job plus the list of created prediction records (each with an internal prediction id) and any immediately-available artifact references. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prompts is missing, empty, contains non-strings/empty strings, or input is not an object; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when batch size or request rate exceeds your limits; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you are not permitted to create predictions.

prompts.description: Array of text prompts to generate images for (one prediction per prompt).

model_ref.description: Replicate model reference/version to use (defaults to Flux Schnell if omitted).

input.description: Additional Replicate model input parameters to merge into each prompt request.

tool_schemas.name: generate_image_variants
tool_schemas.description: Creates a variant-set job for a single prompt and requests num_outputs variants from the selected Replicate model, returning the job and the created prediction record(s) with ids to poll along with any available artifact references. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prompt is missing/empty, num_outputs is not a positive integer, model_ref is invalid, or input is not an object; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the requested num_outputs exceeds allowed limits; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you cannot create variant jobs/predictions.

prompt.description: Text prompt to generate variants for.

model_ref.description: Replicate model reference/version to use (defaults to Flux Schnell if omitted).

input.description: Additional Replicate model input parameters to pass through.

tool_schemas.name: generate_svg
tool_schemas.description: Creates an SVG generation job and a Replicate prediction using an SVG-capable model (defaulting to a Recraft model if model_ref is omitted), returning the created prediction record with its internal id and any available SVG artifact references. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prompt is missing/empty, model_ref is invalid/not SVG-capable for this operation, or input is not an object; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when you exceed SVG generation limits; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when you are not permitted to create SVG predictions.

prompt.description: Text prompt to generate an SVG.

model_ref.description: Replicate model reference/version to use (defaults to a Recraft SVG-capable model if omitted).

input.description: Additional Replicate model input parameters to pass through.

tool_schemas.name: get_prediction
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single stored prediction by internal prediction_id and returns its full record, including current status, associated job id (if any), model reference, input, and any persisted output artifact references. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prediction_id does not match the expected format; raises NOT_FOUND if no prediction exists with that id; raises FORBIDDEN if the prediction exists but is not accessible under your credentials.

tool_schemas.name: create_prediction
tool_schemas.description: Creates a Replicate prediction record (and optionally attaches it to an existing generation job via job_id), merging prompt with the provided input payload, and returns the created prediction including its internal prediction id for polling and any available artifact references. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if prompt is missing/empty, job_id/prediction inputs do not match expected formats, model_ref is invalid, or input is not an object; raises NOT_FOUND if job_id is provided but no such job exists; raises CONFLICT if the job exists but is not in a state that accepts new predictions; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when limits or permissions prevent creation.

prompt.description: Text prompt to create a Replicate prediction for.

model_ref.description: Replicate model reference/version to use (defaults to Flux Schnell if omitted).

input.description: Full Replicate prediction input payload (merged with prompt if both provided).

job_id.description: Optional existing generation job id to attach this prediction to.

tool_schemas.name: prediction_list
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of stored predictions, optionally filtered by status and/or job_id and sorted by created time; results are limited by limit and the response includes an opaque next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is not a positive integer, cursor is invalid, status/sort is not one of the allowed values, or job_id format is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if job_id is provided but no such job exists; raises FORBIDDEN if filtering would expose predictions you are not allowed to access.

limit.description: Maximum number of predictions to return.

job_id.description: Filter predictions by generation job id.

sort.description: Sort order for results (default is newest first if omitted).

tool_schemas.name: get_job
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single stored generation job by id and returns its full record for the calling API key, including derived job status and the list of linked Replicate predictions (and optionally their outputs). Raises NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist and FORBIDDEN if it belongs to a different API key.

include_predictions.description: When true, includes linked replicate_predictions records.

include_outputs.description: When true, includes prediction_outputs for each linked prediction (requires include_predictions=true).

tool_schemas.name: job_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored generation jobs for the calling API key, ordered by most recent first. Supports filtering by status/job_type and paginated access. Refuses requests without a valid active API key and never returns jobs belonging to other API keys.

status.description: Optional filter to only return jobs in the given status.

job_type.description: Optional filter to only return jobs of the given type.

tool_name.description: Optional filter for jobs created by a given tool (when tracked on the job).

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call to job_list.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_job
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running generation job for the calling API key and attempts to cancel any non-terminal linked Replicate predictions. Returns the updated job (and any updated predictions). Refuses cancellation for terminal jobs (succeeded/failed/cancelled) and refuses requests for jobs owned by other API keys.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the cancellation (stored for auditing/debugging).

tool_schemas.name: cancel_prediction
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a non-terminal stored prediction for the calling API key (starting/processing) and, when possible, issues a cancellation request to Replicate for the underlying replicate_prediction_id. Returns the updated prediction record including status. Refuses cancellation for terminal predictions (succeeded/failed/canceled) and refuses requests for predictions owned by other API keys.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the cancellation (stored for auditing/debugging).

metadata.name: Replicate Flux MCP
metadata.description: This backend stores Replicate-based generation requests (predictions) and their produced artifacts (images/SVGs), grouped into user-visible "jobs" such as single-image generation, multi-prompt batches, and variant sets. The main workflow is: create a generation job -> create one or more Replicate pr
